subject: ADR-178: the protocol library's predictions hold -- two ready-made experiments rewritten to the bands their data sits in, republished, held by the task and the suite
body: ADR-177'S FINDING, CLOSED. Four predictions on two ready-made protocols were refuted by the kit's own instruments with comments asserting them: evenness(pondA) is uneven (J' 0.763, MODERATE), brayCurtis(pondA, pondB) > 0.4 (0.311), evenness(morning) is uneven (0.894, VERY-EVEN), brayCurtis(morning, afternoon) > 0.3 (0.237). An unannounced wrong prediction in a library that calls itself ready to run teaches that the bands are unreliable, when it is the prediction that never consulted them. The four lines are rewritten to what the data supports, in the report's own bands, with the reason in the comment: evenness(pondA) is moderate; turnover(pondA, pondB) is moderate (checked in the engine and the lab's importer first); evenness(morning) is very-even; brayCurtis(morning, afternoon) > 0.2. Every protocol grades fully confirmed except the meadow's one deliberate refutation. Page republished (d608dd5a), read back, stamped, swept: 42 of 42 measured from the live page. The reference task presses the second Copy and holds two-ponds.eco whole, 12 -> 17 confirmed. verify_epl: KNOWN_REFUTED empty, the four lines held by name, 40 -> 42. Noted, not done: the .eco Reference's band words (even / uneven) are not the engine's (very-even / moderate / uneven / dominated; low / moderate / major).
